The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIA Project Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Project Assistant (IIA/11/2026-27/01 & IIA/11/2026-27/02): Master's or BS-MS degree in Physics/Mathematics or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology with 60% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade from the recognized University /Institution under UGC or Central or State Governments.

content_sections.heading: IIA Project Assistant Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: IIA Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIA Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIA Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and candidates need to attend the interview on 06-10-2026. There is no separate application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's or BS-MS degree in Physics/Mathematics or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Assistant position at the Indian Institute of Astrophysics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Institute Campus, 2nd Block, Koramangala, Sarjapur Road, Bangalore – 560 034.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates related to their qualification and experience, along with one set of self-certified photocopies and a passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
